event_moving_rat.png:
A single scene illustration for a story event in a cute cartoon roguelike card game, landscape composition.

Scene: a plump brown rat with a huge cloth bundle strapped to its back is crouched on a stone stair, its belongings spread out around it; it holds out one paw toward the ninja cat, offering a swap, while its other paw is already reaching toward the small pouch on the cat's belt. The cat stands facing it, one paw protectively over the pouch, ears back, unsure

IMPORTANT about any writing in this scene: brush marks and scratches only - abstract squiggles that read as writing from a distance. Never draw real letters, words, numbers or recognisable characters of any language.

THE CAT: whenever the grey tabby cat ninja appears, draw it EXACTLY like the cat in the attached reference sheet.
Copy the reference's proportions — this is the part that keeps going wrong, so be strict:
big round head roughly as large as the body, large round eyes with big dark pupils, tiny muzzle,
short chubby body, thick black outline, flat colouring, navy headband with two trailing tails, navy ninja outfit.
Do NOT draw a realistic cat and do NOT stretch its body out.

Tell the story in one readable picture: clear staging, strong silhouettes, expressive faces, only what the
scene needs. It will be shown about 420 pixels wide, so no fine detail that disappears when shrunk.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors with subtle soft gradients, cute cartoon storybook look,
not photorealistic. Warm torch-lit tower interior lighting unless the scene says otherwise.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no user interface, no border.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying - draw only the
characters and the few props the scene needs, standing on nothing.
Output 1024x768 PNG. Save the image as event_moving_rat.png in the current directory and report the path.
